meta.name: Hungry: Cucina Amore
meta.description:
Hungry is dedicated to food and cooking, featuring such celebrity chefs as Graham Kerr, Julia Child, Jacques Pepin, Nick Stellino, Roy Yamaguchi, Pati Jinich, Walter Staib, Jim Coleman, and others.

Shows: Cucina Amore, Lidia's Kitchen, Ellie's Real Good Food, Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home, Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
